image_description: Two bison standing on a paved road next to a wooden fence post. The bison in the foreground is dark brown with a prominent shoulder hump and shaggy fur, facing right. The bison in the background is lighter brown, also facing right, partially obscured by the fence post. A sign reading 'Canyon Overlook' is visible in the background among trees.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large broad head with short curved horns.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Both bison display large, broad heads. The foreground bison clearly shows short, curved black horns consistent with the species.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Beard of long hair on chin and throat.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The foreground bison has a distinct beard of long, dark hair hanging from its chin and throat area.
The eye of the foreground bison is visible and appears dark, consistent with the description.
Ears are not prominently sticking out; they appear small and are largely obscured by the thick fur of the head and hump.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Massive body with exceptionally tall, heavily built proportions at the withers.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Both animals exhibit the characteristic massive build and high withers typical of bison.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Shaggy dark brown fur covering forequarters forming prominent shoulder hump.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The foreground bison has very shaggy, dark brown fur on its front half, creating a very prominent shoulder hump. The background bison is lighter but still shows the hump structure.
The transition from the shaggy front to the smoother, shorter-haired hindquarters is visible on both animals, particularly the foreground one.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Short horns compared to body size.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The horns are relatively small and short in proportion to the massive head and body size.
Legs appear sturdy and thick. Hooves are visible on the foreground bison's feet, appearing dark and solid.
The tails of both bison are either occluded by their bodies or the angle makes them impossible to see clearly.

artifact_observations.location: Background bison's rear legs and underbelly
artifact_observations.reasoning: The rear legs of the background bison appear to merge indistinctly with the ground and each other. The anatomy near the udder/underbelly area is vague and lacks clear structural definition, suggesting melting or fusion artifacts common in AI generation.
While generally good, some areas of the shaggy fur have a slightly 'painted' or overly smooth texture rather than individual hair strands, particularly on the flank.

The wooden fence post in the foreground seems to float slightly or lack a solid connection to the ground. The text on the sign is legible but the geometry of the signpost itself feels slightly warped relative to the horizon.
